cat.text: A back door standing open, a garage light on. Inside: the owner's teenage son, who forgot his key and climbed in through the window.

options.text: Verify who he is and clear it.

door.text: The back door of a renovated Victorian is pried open. Something moves upstairs.

options.text: Announce and wait at the door.
Clear the house room by room.

door_announce.text: "Police! Come out with your hands up!" A long silence, then footsteps on the back stairs, fast.

options.text: Hold the door and call the airship.

success.note: He's gone over the back fence by the time it's overhead.

alley.text: In the alley: a shopping cart full of picture frames and a man trying to climb the fence with a bag.

success.note: You both hit the ground. He stays down.

failure.note: He drops down on your side, swinging.
